package task

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

func validateSandboxRuntime(ctx context.Context, lessons repository.LessonRepository, task *domain.Task) error {
	if !task.RequiresSandbox || task.ComposeConfigID != nil || domain.HasComposeConfig(task.ComposeConfig) {
		return nil
	}
	if lessons == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: sandbox task requires task or lesson compose config", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	lesson, err := lessons.Get(ctx, task.LessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if lesson.ComposeConfigID == nil && !domain.HasComposeConfig(lesson.ComposeConfig) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: sandbox task requires task or lesson compose config", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return nil
}
